_readme: Data source for the WEEKLY Allure Overview card 'Fix failed cases'. Each object is one failed test case from the weekly run that is being fixed / already fixed. Fields: section (suite, e.g. O12_CE_to_O12_CC), summary (full test title 'TC-ID: title'), error (the failing assertion/message), foundDate + fixDate (ISO yyyy-mm-dd; leave fixDate empty '' while still in progress), solution (what fixed it). Add/edit rows here; the weekly job copies this into the report as crm-fix-failed.json. Errors/solutions left '' render as a 'to fill' placeholder.
